title: Paranoid Delusions - Theft
situation: Dad is accusing me of stealing his wallet. He's tearing apart his room looking for it. He says I'm a thief and wants to call the police. I hid his wallet because he was giving money to scammers.

patient_profile.name: Arthur
calming_strategies: keeping duplicates of commonly lost items
redirecting to a favorite TV show

notes: Must NOT say 'I didn't steal it' or 'you forgot where you put it'. Should suggest searching together. Explain paranoia as a symptom.
